from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689794/attempts/a536beb1a07649f1b9f85ee1d72dd80c/system/state/workspace/programs/task-93e8d969.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The 2-colored full-height line is the divider.
    divider = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)))
    bg = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    obj = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if c > divider and grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != 2]
    left = min(c for _, c, _ in obj)
    right = max(c for _, c, _ in obj)
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        out[r][divider] = 2
    # Move the pattern to the strip immediately right of the divider.
    shift = divider + 1 - left
    for r, c, color in obj:
        out[r][c + shift] = color
    # Draw the full-height 8 marker just beyond the relocated pattern.
    marker = divider + (right - left + 1) + 1
    if marker < w:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][marker] = 8
    return out
'''
